evidenceBoundary: The Help Center companion is rendered in Chromium against an isolated local window.ryu host fixture. The fixture persists Space documents, records exact storage/Space/model calls, and can fail selected operations once. Browser tests verify visible queue filters, ticket selection, durable document writes and readback, AI prompt/retrieval payloads, article lifecycle, activation retry, and recovery after save/retrieval failures. No live Core, customer, or model provider is contacted.
